name: Verdant Engine Observer model
statement: Verdant Engine's Observer: a self-observing second-order Prism holon that composes its organs, a full Prism model per stakeholder that it observes, and Prism ID signed, SOSA and PROV-O observed communication channels, among them channels between people and agents and between agents. Only its runtime holon, stakeholder models and channels are cited, not its Studio organ (REQ-ENGINE-RUNTIME-ONLY). Cited by REQ-AGENT-OBSERVER.
